summary.plain: The VERITAS array of four 12 m gamma-ray telescopes at the Fred Lawrence Whipple Observatory basecamp on Mount Hopkins, Arizona.
summary.technical: One local map for facility:fred-lawrence-whipple-observatory. VERITAS is drawn as a single reference point at its own official published coordinate; the four individual telescopes (T1-T4, ~35-127 m apart) are not resolved separately this session (see geometry record notes).
